why: A filled mark is a solid blob at strip size, where the glyph is under a line-height tall: the triangle and the starburst stop being distinguishable outlines and read as two similar lumps, which loses exactly the recognition the `shape` style is a candidate for. `fill="none"` also keeps the mark honest under forced colours, where a filled shape is repainted as one flat mass. The anchor carries `stroke-width="0.18"` deliberately -- the achievement padlock a few lines above uses the same `fill="none" stroke="currentColor"` opening, and an anchor without the width mutates the padlock instead, which no case here covers.
killedBy: hud: identity mark in the stock strip (issue #778) paints on currentColor, so forced colours repaints it instead of dropping it
